title: کلید و هزارتو
logline_fa: کلیدی کوچک با دو چشم باید از هزارتویی از دیوارها بگذرد و قفلی را پیدا کند؛ دوربین همراهش می‌دود و آخرین پیچ همه‌چیز را عوض می‌کند.

protagonist.what: a brass key with two dot eyes
protagonist.build: SVG key body + 2 eyes; hops with squash/stretch around the key-tip pivot; trail as a fading dashed path
protagonist.state_change: worried and hesitant at 0s -> confident running -> turns in lock, door opens, eyes close happy

emotional_arc: lost -> trying -> dead end -> insight -> success

beats.what: key placed at maze entrance, zoom out
camera follows key through turns; hits one dead end and reverses
speed-up: walls slide to make the way, one continuous run
lock found, key turns, door opens on warm light, copy

assets: SVG maze generated by a seeded algorithm, key, lock, door
kit sfx: bonk, whoosh, stone slide, metal click, warm chord

tests: persistent actor across cuts and camera
likely_skill_gaps: no path-follow helper (position on polyline by arc length)
acceptance: payoff offsets <= 5 ms on all 4 payoffs
transition strip: key position continuous across camera moves
